- Total revenue reached £23.4k TW versus £14.7k LW, a WoW increase of 59.2%, on 8,300 units and 425 orders TW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER ranked 1 TW with £2,009.77 and an 8.6% share of total revenue, despite a WoW decline of £1,731.21.
- COOK WITH WINE METAL SIGN ranked 2 TW with £1,506.02 and a 6.4% share, up £1,459.22 WoW (+3,118.0%).
- DOOR MAT RED SPOT ranked 3 TW with £1,497.76 and a 6.4% share, adding £1,497.76 WoW.
- DOOR MAT BLACK FLOCK delivered £1,321.48 TW and RETRO SPOT CAKE STAND delivered £1,092.98 TW.
- The top 5 products accounted for 31.8% of total revenue TW.
- PLEASE ONE PERSON METAL SIGN rose 2,101.3% WoW, the second largest percentage gain TW.
- RED HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER fell £859.91 WoW (-47.6%) and DOOR MAT UNION FLAG fell 51.3% WoW.
